title: "1,234" + 1 is 1235: a thousands separator is accepted in text converted to a number

source.quote: the string is automatically converted into a corresponding number, as long as the string is a valid representation of a number
source.supports: text in an arithmetic expression converts when it is a valid number; the page does not say which forms are valid

source.quote: DAX implicitly converts the string to a number, and then does the addition for a numeric result

derivation: + converts text to a number when the text is a valid representation of a number. In en-US 1,234 is the usual way to write 1234, so it is taken as valid: 1234 + 1 = 1235.
alternative: No source says whether a group separator is accepted. If it is not, the conversion fails and the query returns an error.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says whether a number that came from text is an integer or a decimal number.
